title: Your Own Payoffs Don't Set Your Own Odds
summary: When no pure strategy is safe both players randomise, and each one's mixing probability is read off the opponent's payoffs rather than their own. Drag a payoff and watch the wrong line move.

sources.title: Nash, Equilibrium Points in N-Person Games, PNAS 1950
Maynard Smith and Price, The Logic of Animal Conflict, Nature 1973 (hawk and dove)
Robinson, An Iterative Method of Solving a Game, Annals of Mathematics 1951 (fictitious play)
